content.title: About
content.content: Flavored rice mixture with cheese is a ready‑to‑cook blend of parboiled rice, seasonings and dried cheese powder. When rehydrated with hot water or milk, it becomes a creamy, aromatic side dish that can be served alone or alongside meat and vegetables.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mix is popular in school cafeterias and backpacking meals because it cooks quickly.
The cheese component is usually a dry milk powder that regains flavor after hydration.
Typical spices include paprika, garlic and dried herbs, giving the dish a distinctive aroma.
Shelf life of the dry product can reach up to 12 months when stored properly.
In many countries the product is sold under different brand names, but the basic recipe remains similar.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Rice provides a fast‑acting source of energy suitable for active lifestyles.

items.title: Contains calcium
items.content: The cheese powder adds calcium, important for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: B1, B3 and B6 support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The dry mix has a modest fat content, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Provides some protein
items.content: Cheese powder contributes a modest amount of plant‑based protein for tissue repair.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The dried cheese may trigger allergic reactions in individuals sensitive to dairy.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Rice can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The blend often contains added salt; those watching sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: May contain gluten cross‑contamination
items.content: Some manufacturers process the mix on equipment that also handles gluten‑containing foods.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour the specified amount of hot water (or milk) over the mix, cover, and let stand for 5‑7 minutes. Optional additions include fresh vegetables, herbs, or diced ham for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place, tightly sealed. After opening, transfer to an airtight container to prevent moisture absorption.
